pages.text: The STAT Mod adds a deep RPG progression system to Minecraft. You have 23 stats across 5 categories: Combat, Magic, Survival, Crafting, and Mental.$(br2)Each stat can be leveled from 0 to 100 by performing related actions.

Stats provide passive bonuses that scale with level. At levels 20, 50, and 80, you unlock perks and passive skills. At level 100, you unlock a powerful active skill.$(br2)Use /statmod list to see your current levels.
